description: Fork of exp278 (dual-stream, ffn_lut+skip, soft residual_lut). Two coupled changes: (1) d_v 24 -> 64; (2) out_proj uses partition_sets = [head_0_idx, ..., head_5_idx]. Each individual anchor pair (a, b) has both indices in the same head's d_v slice (intra-head per pair); BUT within a single table, the NAP=6 pairs can come from DIFFERENT heads (pair 1 from head 0, pair 2 from head 3, etc.). So a table still mixes information across heads at the lookup-key level — just via head-internal pairs, not cross-head pairs. Single out_proj LUT, input_dim=384, tph=2048 flat across layers, NAP=6. Different from exp279 (per-head ModuleList): exp279 binds tables to one head; exp281 lets each table sample its 6 pairs from any head with the only restriction being a/b same-head. Uses partition_sets feature whose soft/multi-alt guards were just lifted. Comparator: exp278=1.7284, exp279 early curve.
